visual_review.summary_en: Sixteen frames broadly follow the actual leg phases, bends and overlaps. Head registration, scale and paw-height differences remain; exact pose replication and a seamless loop are unverified.

phases.observation: Extended flight; forelegs forward at separate heights; hindlegs trail right.
Forelegs lower sequentially, support and fold back beneath body while hindlegs recover forward.
Compact gathering; forefeet tuck backward and hindfeet swing forward then descend. Far limbs partly occluded by dark fur.
Hindlegs separate, support and push back while forelegs remain folded. Final13 retains12 head/body camera registration better; low hindfoot moves beneath body and lowers.
Forelegs reopen toward left while hindlegs extend back toward flight.

continuity_limits.observation: Nose shifts left about80px (qualitative visual estimate), greater than source projection shift.
Additional head movement roughly45–55px beyond mapped source movement.
Head rises then lowers; lowest paw/floor heights differ slightly.
Targeted fourth13candidate substantially reduces12→13jump.13→14still changes head/coat size and position.
Leg phases cycle in expected order, but head/neck size changes and muzzle moves about100px right (qualitative estimate).

observation_limits: Black source fur and blur obscure exact anatomical left/right limb assignment and ground contact.
Distinct file hashes establish different bytes, not different pose geometry.
Output PNGs were not resized, pixel-edited or interpolated.
